QUOTE: The high-level bits (`ret & 0xFF80`) go to `mbedtls_high_level_strerr` ... The low-level bits (`ret & ~0xFF80`) go to `mbedtls_low_level_strerr` ... If both parts are present, the high-level string is followed by `" : "` and then the low-level string.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer describes the high-level module part and low-level part of the code, and says both are rendered joined with " : " when both are present.
